setupHint: Sign in with Google to show your meetings.
serviceMissing: Kaigi service is not running. Enable it with: omarchy plugin enable penguinwokrs.kaigi
google.setupSteps: First-time setup (free): in Google Cloud Console create a project, enable the Google Calendar API, set up the OAuth consent screen and publish it to Production, then create an OAuth client ID of type “Desktop app” and download its JSON. Then press “Import downloaded JSON”.
google.waiting: Finish signing in in your browser…
settings.title: Kaigi Settings
settings.autoJoin.label: Join meetings automatically
settings.autoJoin.desc: Open the meeting link when it is time
settings.pendingAutoJoin: Also auto-join invitations you haven't answered, from:
settings.pendingAutoJoin.note: Turned off, a calendar's unanswered invitations are not opened automatically. You still get their notifications.
settings.pendingAutoJoin.hidden: Unanswered invitations are hidden on the Events tab, so none of them are auto-joined.
settings.actionsNote: Declined, cancelled and all-day events are skipped, as are events hidden on the Events tab.
settings.profileNote: Used only with the web app window. If you keep Google accounts in separate profiles, pick the one signed in with the meeting's account. Calendars can override it on the Calendars tab.
settings.accountProfile: Chrome profile for this account's meetings
settings.ongoing.hide: Switch to the next at start
settings.onlySoon.desc: Later events show just the icon
settings.eventsNote: Events you set to hide also get no notifications or auto-join.
settings.filterRegexes: Hide events whose title matches (regex, one per line)
settings.customRegexes: Extra meeting links (regex, one per line)
settings.regexNote: Saved when the field loses focus.
settings.graceNote: After suspend, notifications and auto-join still run if no more than this late.
settings.servicesNote: When an app is chosen but not installed, the link opens in the browser instead. Links of every other supported service (69 in all) are detected too and open as set in “Open in”.
appUnavailable.title: %1 app not found
appUnavailable.body: Opening the meeting in the browser instead.
settings.bookmarks: Meeting links you use often, one per line: a name, then the URL
settings.bookmarksNote: They are listed in the popup and open in the same way as meetings.
settings.hooks.label: Run hooks when meetings start and end
settings.hooks.desc: Runs your own scripts through omarchy-hook
settings.hooksNote: Put executable scripts at ~/.config/omarchy/hooks/kaigi-event-start and kaigi-event-end. They get the title, start and end (ISO 8601), meeting link and calendar name as arguments.
settings.dismissed.count: %1 events are hidden. They get no notifications or auto-join either.
settings.dismissed.none: No events are hidden. To hide one, open its details in the popup and choose "Hide this event".
